item.title: John Deatrich Announces Candidacy for 123rd District State House Seat
item.description: John Deatrich has announced his candidacy for Pennsylvania State Representative in the 123rd Legislative District. Deatrich, a lifelong resident of the district, confirmed his campaign on February 2, saying he plans to bring his experience in education, organized labor, and local government to Harrisburg. item.title: Schuylkill County Commissioners Focus on Local impacts Tied to proposed ICE facility
item.description: Schuylkill County Commissioners say their focus is squarely on local impacts after confirmation that the federal government has purchased a large warehouse in Tremont Township for what is expected to become an Immigration and Customs Enforcement detention facility. A deed recorded earlier this week shows the U.S. Department of Homeland Security acquired the former Big Lots distribution center along Rausch Creek Road for approximately $119.5 million. item.title: Schuylkill County Democratic Committee Announces Opposition to Proposed Tremont ICE Facility
item.description: The Schuylkill County Democratic Committee (SCDC) says it plans to formally oppose the proposed federal immigration detention facility in Tremont Township, citing financial, legal, and humanitarian concerns. In a statement released Tuesday following a committee meeting, Chairman Todd Zimmerman said the organization intends to work alongside residents and a newly forming non-partisan coalition aimed at coordinating legal and civic efforts to challenge the project.
